sentences.en: DAN: Hi Jeannie
sentences.zh: DAN: 嗨，珍妮。

sentences.en: How's it going?
sentences.zh: 最近怎么样？

sentences.en: JEANNIE: Oh, hello Dan
sentences.zh: JEANNIE: 哦，你好，丹。

sentences.en: Pretty well, thanks
sentences.zh: 还不错，谢谢。

sentences.en: Have you managed to get the money for the course yet?
sentences.zh: 你已经弄到课程费用了吗？

sentences.en: DAN: Yes, that's all sorted out now, thanks
sentences.zh: DAN: 是的，这事现在已经全部搞定了，谢谢。

sentences.en: It took long enough, though
sentences.zh: 不过花的时间可真够长的。

sentences.en: It was practically a year ago that I applied to my local council for a grant, and it took them six months to turn me down
sentences.zh: 差不多一年前我就向我所在的地方议会申请了助学金，结果他们花了六个月才拒绝我。

sentences.en: JEANNIE: That's really slow
sentences.zh: JEANNIE: 这确实太慢了。

sentences.en: DAN: And I thought I was eligible for government funding, but it seems I was mistaken
sentences.zh: DAN: 我本以为自己有资格获得政府资助，但看来我搞错了。

sentences.en: So then I asked the boss of the company I used to work for if they would sponsor me, and much to my surprise, he said they'd make a contribution
sentences.zh: 于是，我又去问了以前工作过的那家公司的老板，看他们是否愿意资助我；令我大感意外的是，他答应出资22英镑。

sentences.en: JEANNIE: But what about college grants and scholarships?
sentences.zh: JEANNIE: 那学院助学金和奖学金呢？

sentences.en: There must be some you could apply for
sentences.zh: 肯定还有些你可以申请的吧？

sentences.en: DAN: Yes, there are, but they're all so small that I decided to leave them until was desperate
sentences.zh: DAN: 是有，但金额都太小了，所以我决定等实在走投无路时再申请。

sentences.en: JEANNIE: Uhuh
sentences.zh: JEANNIE: 嗯。

sentences.en: DAN: And in fact I didn't need to apply
sentences.zh: DAN: 结果事实上我根本不需要去申请。

sentences.en: My parents had been saying that as already had a job, a ought to support myself through college
sentences.zh: 我父母一直说，既然我已经有了工作，就该自己负担大学学费。

sentences.en: But in the end they took pity on me, so now I've just about got enough
sentences.zh: 但最后他们还是可怜我，所以现在我的钱差不多够用了。

sentences.en: JEANNIE: That's good
sentences.zh: JEANNIE: 那太好了。

sentences.en: DAN: So now can put a bit of effort into meeting people - I haven't had time so far
sentences.zh: DAN: 这下我可以花点精力去结识些朋友了——之前一直没时间。

sentences.en: Any suggestions?
sentences.zh: 你有什么建议吗？

sentences.en: JEANNIE: What about joining some college clubs?
sentences.zh: JEANNIE: 加入一些学院社团怎么样？

sentences.en: DAN: Oh right
sentences.zh: DAN: 哦，对。

sentences.en: You joined several didn't you?
sentences.zh: 你加入了好几个，是吧？

sentences.en: JEANNIE: Yes, I'm in the drama club
sentences.zh: JEANNIE: 是的，我参加了戏剧社。

sentences.en: I'm hoping to be in the spring production, too
sentences.zh: 我还希望能参加春季的演出。

sentences.en: DAN: I've never liked acting
sentences.zh: DAN: 我从来都不喜欢演戏。

sentences.en: Are you doing anything else?
sentences.zh: 你还参加了别的活动吗？

sentences.en: JEANNIE: I enjoyed singing when I was at school, so I joined a group when I came to college
sentences.zh: JEANNIE: 我上学时很喜欢唱歌，所以来到大学后就加入了一个合唱团。

sentences.en: I don't think the conductor stretches us enough, though so I'lI give up after the next concert
sentences.zh: 不过我觉得指挥对我们要求不够严格，因此我打算在下场音乐会之后退出。

sentences.en: And I also joined the debating society
sentences.zh: 另外，我还加入了辩论社。

sentences.en: It's fun, but with all the rehearsing I'm doing, something has to go, and I'm & afraid that's the one
sentences.zh: 这挺有趣的，但因为我正在大量排练，总得放弃点什么，而恐怕这个就要被放弃了。

sentences.en: DAN: Do you do any sports?
sentences.zh: DAN: 你参加体育运动吗？

sentences.en: JEANNIE: Yes, I'm in one of the hockey teams
sentences.zh: JEANNIE: 参加了，我在一支曲棍球队里。

sentences.en: I'm not very good, but I'd really miss it if I stopped
sentences.zh: 我打得不太好，但如果停止参加，我肯定会非常想念。

sentences.en: I decided to try tennis when I came to college, and I'm finding it pretty tough going
sentences.zh: 来大学后，我还尝试打网球，发现这相当吃力。

sentences.en: I'm simply not fit enough
sentences.zh: 我的体能根本不够。

sentences.en: DAN: Nor me
sentences.zh: DAN: 我也是。

sentences.en: I think I'll give that a miss!
sentences.zh: 我想我就不参加那个了！

sentences.en: JEANNIE: I'm hoping it'll help me to build up my stamina, but it'll probably be a long haul
sentences.zh: JEANNIE: 我希望这能帮助我增强耐力，但很可能需要很长时间。

sentences.en: DAN: Good luck
sentences.zh: DAN: 祝你好运。

sentences.en: JEANNIE: Thanks
sentences.zh: JEANNIE: 谢谢。

sentences.en: DAN: How are you finding the course?
sentences.zh: DAN: 你觉得这门课程怎么样？

sentences.en: JEANNIE: I wish we had more seminars
sentences.zh: JEANNIE: 我真希望我们能有更多研讨会。

sentences.en: DAN: What?
sentences.zh: DAN: 什么？

sentences.en: I'd have thought we had more than enough already
sentences.zh: 我本以为我们已经够多了。

sentences.en: All those people saying clever things that I could never think of - it's quite interesting, but I wonder if I'm clever enough to be doing this course
sentences.zh: 所有那些人说着我永远也想不到的聪明话——这确实很有趣，但我怀疑自己是否聪明到足以修读这门课程。

sentences.en: JEANNIE: find it helpful to listen to the other people. like the way we're exploring the subject, and working towards getting insight into it
sentences.zh: JEANNIE: 我觉得听其他人的发言很有帮助，比如我们如何探索这个主题，并逐步深入理解它。

sentences.en: DAN: How do you get on with your tutor?
sentences.zh: DAN: 你和你的导师相处得怎么样？

sentences.en: I don't think I'm on the same wavelength as mine, so I feel I'm not getting anything out of the tutorials
sentences.zh: 我觉得我和我的导师完全不在一个频道上，因此我觉得辅导课对我毫无收获。

sentences.en: It would be more productive to read a book instead
sentences.zh: 与其这样，还不如去读书更有成效。

sentences.en: JEANNIE: Oh, I've got much better at writing essays
sentences.zh: JEANNIE: 哦，我现在写论文的能力强多了。

sentences.en: And she's helping me plan my mine's very demanding
sentences.zh: 她正在帮我规划我的论文——她的要求非常高。

sentences.en: She gives me lots of feedback and advice, So revision for the end-of-year exams
sentences.zh: 她给了我大量反馈和建议，以便我为期末考试复习。

sentences.en: DAN: Do tell me, I always struggle with revision
sentences.zh: DAN: 快告诉我吧，我总在复习上遇到困难。

sentences.en: JEANNIE: Well, the first thing is to find out exactly what's required in the exams
sentences.zh: JEANNIE: 好吧，首先要弄清楚考试到底考什么内容。

sentences.en: DAN: Mm
sentences.zh: DAN: 嗯。

sentences.en: Would it help to get hold of some past papers?
sentences.zh: 找几份往年试卷来参考会有帮助吗？

sentences.en: JEANNIE: Yes
sentences.zh: JEANNIE: 有帮助。

sentences.en: They'll help to make it clear
sentences.zh: 它们有助于让考试要求更清晰明了。

sentences.en: DAN: Right, I'll do that
sentences.zh: DAN: 好的，我这就去做。

sentences.en: Then what?
sentences.zh: 然后呢？

sentences.en: JEANNIE: Then you can sort out your revision priorities, based on what's most likely to come up
sentences.zh: JEANNIE: 接着你可以根据最可能考到的内容，来确定复习的优先顺序。

sentences.en: I put these on a card, and read them through regularly
sentences.zh: 我把这些要点写在卡片上，然后定期通读。

sentences.en: DAN: Uhuh
sentences.zh: DAN: 嗯。

sentences.en: JEANNIE: But that isn't enough in itself
sentences.zh: JEANNIE: 但光这样做本身还不够。

sentences.en: You also need a timetable, to see how you can fit everything in, in the time available
sentences.zh: 你还需要制定一份时间表，看看如何在有限的时间内安排好所有复习任务。

sentences.en: Then keep it in front of you while you're studying
sentences.zh: 然后在学习时把时间表放在眼前。

sentences.en: DAN: I've done that before, but it hasn't helped me!
sentences.zh: DAN: 我以前试过，但没起作用！

sentences.en: JEANNIE: Maybe you need to do something different every day, so if you break down your revision into small tasks, and allocate them to specific days, there's more incentive to tackle them
sentences.zh: JEANNIE: 也许你需要每天做点不同的事；如果你把复习内容分解成小任务，并分配到具体日期，就更有动力去完成它们。

sentences.en: With big topics you're more likely to put off starting
sentences.zh: 面对大主题时，你更容易拖延开始。

sentences.en: SLA
sentences.zh: SLA

sentences.en: DAN: Good idea
sentences.zh: DAN: 好主意。

sentences.en: JEANNIE: And as I revise each topic I write a single paragraph about AT then later 216802.com can read it through quickly, and it helps fix things in my mind
sentences.zh: JEANNIE: 而且我在复习每个主题时，都会写一段简短的文字总结；之后我可以快速通读一遍，这有助于将知识牢牢记住。

sentences.en: DAN: That's brilliant
sentences.zh: DAN: 这太棒了。

sentences.en: JEANNIE: I also write answers to questions for the exam practice
sentences.zh: JEANNIE: 我还会针对考试练习，写出问题的答案。

sentences.en: It's hard to make myself do it, though!
sentences.zh: 不过，强迫自己这么做真的很难！

sentences.en: DAN: Well, I'll try
sentences.zh: DAN: 好吧，我试试。

sentences.en: Thanks a lot, Jeannie
sentences.zh: 非常感谢，珍妮。

sentences.en: That's a great help
sentences.zh: 这真是帮了大忙。

sentences.en: JEANNIE: No problem
sentences.zh: JEANNIE: 没问题。

sentences.en: DAN: See you around
sentences.zh: DAN: 回头见。

sentences.en: JEANNIE: Bye
sentences.zh: JEANNIE: 再见。
